text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Yamanin Zephyr's debut. With this race being on an entirely different level from scrimmages, it'd make sense for her to be nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet, she seems as relaxed as usual, barely paying the spectators and other runners any mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She readies herself for the race, concerned only with becoming the wind on the turf.
